Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD into Disbelief with medium conviction while the narrative implies an imminent directional upside surprise; the judge sides with the analyst's base-rate discipline and higher trust weight.
